title: Ancient Stories of Where the Jews Came From
aka: Tacitus on the origin of the Jews
lead: Greek, Egyptian and Roman writers gave several accounts of the Jews' beginning, most of them placing it in Egypt, Crete, Ethiopia or Assyria. Tacitus lists five and prefers the story of an Egyptian plague and exile under Moyses; Josephus answered such stories in Against Apion. The Bible's own account is Genesis and Exodus.
